title: Pupusas Revuelta
description: Pupusas Revuelta is a dish from El Salvador featuring masa harina, ground pork, canned black beans, mozzarella. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Mix the corn flour with the measured water and salt until a soft cohesive, non-sticky masa forms. Rest covered for about 10 minutes; this gluten-free dough does not become elastic like wheat dough.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Form thick masa discs around the already cooked pork, bean and cheese filling, sealing all seams so cheese stays inside.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 20 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
